verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only static documentation with a copyable curl snippet for creating verification sessions. Nothing documents an interactive API reference (such as an in-browser explorer or a 'try it' console with runnable requests), and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. A static code sample is related documentation, not the interactive reference the story asks for, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
